item.title: Arc of the Ozarks expanding Autism Center to meet demand
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — In 2024, Arc of the Ozarks opened its Autism and Neurodevelopmental Center to address an ever-growing waitlist for families wanting evolutions and potential therapy. item.title: The Pitch Pizza & Pub in Springfield announces closure
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — After nine years, the eatery in the Southern Hills Shopping Center will close this Sunday Feb. 22 according to the owners of the restaurant. It is located at 2924 E. Sunshine in Springfield. The owners posted on Facebook on Friday night that they would be closing, thanking patrons and guests for memories. [...]

item.title: Man in custody after reports of gunfire at Eustasis
item.description: Police responded to reports of a man with a gun and shots fired at a psychiatric and addiction health facility in Springfield, Mo. on Friday, but no one was injured and the shooter was taken into custody.
